Short, choppy platinum-white hair with asymmetrical bangs and a messy texture. Sharp, narrow electric-yellow eyes with a smug, arrogant expression. Apparent age in the mid-teens with a youthful yet mature demeanor. Slim, petite build. A dark, stylized military coat in shades of onyx and deep indigo with gold buttons. Signature features include a black choker and a heavy, dark-colored mechanical aircraft rigging.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
